AllowPlayerPortraitChanges.Name: Allow player portrait changes
AllowPlayerPortraitChanges.Hint: Allow actor owners to change their RN Portrait Stage portrait. Document permissions are still enforced.

DebugLogging.Name: Debug logging
DebugLogging.Hint: Write additional RN Portrait Stage diagnostic information to the browser console.

ExperimentalVoiceEnabled.Name: Enable experimental voice-activated portraits
ExperimentalVoiceEnabled.Hint: Allow users to opt into local microphone activity detection. No audio is transmitted or recorded by this module.

ModuleVisible.Name: Show portrait stage
ModuleVisible.Hint: Show RN Portrait Stage portrait groups for this user.

PortraitSize.Name: Portrait size
PortraitSize.Hint: Default portrait size for this user, in pixels.

PortraitGap.Name: Portrait spacing
PortraitGap.Hint: Default gap between portraits for this user, in pixels.

PcOffsetX.Name: Character group horizontal offset
PcOffsetX.Hint: Move the character portrait group horizontally, in pixels.

PcOffsetY.Name: Character group vertical offset
PcOffsetY.Hint: Move the character portrait group vertically, in pixels.

NpcOffsetX.Name: NPC group horizontal offset
NpcOffsetX.Hint: Move the NPC portrait group horizontally, in pixels.

NpcOffsetY.Name: NPC group vertical offset
NpcOffsetY.Hint: Move the NPC portrait group vertically, in pixels.

PcDirection.Name: Character group direction
PcDirection.Hint: Choose whether character portraits are arranged from top to bottom or bottom to top.

NpcDirection.Name: NPC group direction
NpcDirection.Hint: Choose whether NPC portraits are arranged from top to bottom or bottom to top.

ReducedMotion.Name: Reduce portrait motion
ReducedMotion.Hint: Reduce or disable non-essential portrait animations for this user.

Manager.Title: RN Portrait Stage — Scene Cast
Manager.Hint: Drag Actors from the Actors directory into either group. Drag entries to reorder or move them between groups.

Notifications.UnsupportedVersion: RN Portrait Stage requires Foundry VTT v13 or v14.
Notifications.GmOnly: Only a Gamemaster can change the scene portrait cast.
Notifications.ActorDropOnly: Only Actors can be added to RN Portrait Stage.
